facts: Fully populate CPU/DIMM/HDD/GPU/network slots and reboot 100 times.
No system/BMC errors, hang/BSOD or device loss.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO due to cold/undervoltage environment; correctly calls this warm OS reboot.
source_snapshot.v2: MANUAL ONLY with cycle checks, OOB and restoration.

original_test_intent.statement: Verify a fully populated platform survives 100 warm OS reboots at 0 C/-5% rails without device loss or platform errors.
must_preserve: Warm rather than AC/cold reboot, complete inventory and exactly 100 cycles.
unknowns: Boot-ready timeout, command, cycle dwell, retry policy and inventory allowlist.

v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: It needs an explicit no-recount/no-hidden-retry rule and per-cycle stable-identity inventory evidence.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep physical margin control manual; bind each of 100 warm reboots to boot-ready, full inventory and log evidence.

revision_candidate.test_name: Perform 100 Fully Populated Warm Reboots at 0 C and -5% Rails
revision_candidate.purpose: Complete 100 OS-initiated reboots with AC continuously present and prove the full stable-identity hardware inventory returns cleanly every cycle.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Signed fully populated server in calibrated 0 C/-5% conditions with condensation control and OOB recovery.
revision_candidate.target_scope: All required CPU threads, DIMMs, storage, GPU UUID/BDFs and NIC interfaces; cycles 1-100 with no count reset.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Approved reboot command, boot-ready signal/timeout, expected inventory, retry policy, error allowlist, fixture limits and recovery.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Operator establishes margin; bounded controller issues one warm reboot per cycle, waits for boot-ready, records stable inventory/log deltas and stops at first policy failure.
revision_candidate.preconditions: No pending update/workload; filesystems and OOB are healthy; environment stable.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Cycle-numbered reboot times/status, inventory diff, OS/BMC/SEL/AER/ECC/XID/storage/network evidence, chamber/rail trace and final restoration.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: All 100 cycles succeed without hidden retry, device loss or disallowed error; warm reboot must not become power cycling.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: No AC interruption, log clearing, silent retry, shortened count or unstable index-only comparison.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Operator controls environment and emergency recovery; owner approves reboot controller/window.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Environment is manual; reboot orchestration may be supervised automation.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Stop loop, restore nominal environment, preserve failed-cycle state and recover via OOB.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Boot timeout, device mismatch, hang/BSOD, error event, moisture, fixture drift or lost OOB.

identified_defects: Per-cycle inventory and retry accounting were implicit.
reason_for_change: The source requires warm reboot, so V3 forbids the cold-power interpretation and makes every one of the 100 cycle results immutable and attributable.
removed_ambiguities: AC stays applied; cycle failures cannot be erased.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 sharpens the warm-versus-cold boundary and prevents a healthy final boot or rerun from hiding an intermediate device-loss event.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Row 62 says warm reboot 100 times at 0 C/-5% with a fully populated platform.
